SELECT 
    YEAR(QuotaDate) AS QuotaYear,
    DATEPART(QUARTER, QuotaDate) AS Quarter,
    SalesQuota,
    VAR_POP(SalesQuota) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(QuotaDate)) AS PopulationVariance
FROM Sales.SalesPersonQuotaHistory
WHERE BusinessEntityID = 277 
  AND YEAR(QuotaDate) = 2012
ORDER BY Quarter;
